source.quote: para satisfazer interesse ou sentimento pessoal

readings.description: Art. 319 applies to judges and members of the Ministério Público on its terms; what keeps an honest interpretation out is the specific purpose the type requires, 'para satisfazer interesse ou sentimento pessoal', a fact to be found, not a class of agents excluded (Fachin and Gilmar Mendes, 2023; Toffoli's revised vote and Zanin, 2025).

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 881, virtual plenary 2025, relator's revised vote, as reported by Migalhas 29.4.2025

readings.description: Legal positions judges and prosecutors take in interpreting the law are categorically outside art. 319; liability remains only for dolo or fraud beyond the ethical and legal limits of the function (Toffoli's 2022 liminar, never referendado).

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 881 MC (Min. Dias Toffoli, 2022), as reported by Conjur 17.10.2023

readings.foreclosure: The liminar was never referendado and its author has since withdrawn it; no merits holding exists (M-sweep-c-02). A Plenary judgment could still adopt it.

taken.rationale: The sweep's suggested reading, and the only one with a vote behind it that has not been withdrawn. The case record carries `posição jurídica interpretativa de membro do Judiciário ou do Ministério Público`, and the rule deliberately does not read it, so the other reading is one line away if the Plenary adopts it.

witnesses: cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `a posição interpretativa por interesse` (crime) and `a posição interpretativa sem interesse` (not), and the assertion that the first equals `o ato contra a lei por interesse`
notes: Reserved id from sweep-c (M-sweep-c-02; disposition of marker V33). Currency risk: ADPF 881 is pending (vista, 29.4.2025).
Resolved, not settled: no court has decided the question.

source.quote: Desacatar funcionário público no exercício da função ou em razão dela

readings.description: Only serious and evident cases of contempt for the public function; officials must tolerate criticism and disapproval.

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 496/DF, Tribunal Pleno, j. 22.6.2020, ementa item 5 (DOU 23.11.2022, via the Senado norma page)

readings.description: Any act of 'desacatar' an official in or because of the function, as the text reads.
readings.foreclosure: The Plenary's ementa in ADPF 496 confines the offence to grave and evident cases; the thesis it fixed ('Foi recepcionada ...') says nothing against that, so the wider reading survives only if the ementa's item 5 is read as obiter.

taken.rationale: The Plenary said so in the judgment that upheld the article; whether a given disrespect is grave and evident contempt is a judgement, so it is the judge's finding, an input.

delegated_field: `Fato de desacato`'s `menosprezo grave e evidente à função pública, reconhecido pelo juiz`
witnesses: cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4: `a crítica que o juiz não achou grave` — not desacato
notes: Reserved id from sweep-c (M-sweep-c-05). Marked resolved rather than settled: the restriction is in the ementa, not in the thesis the STF fixed.

source.quote_absent_reason: The insignificância principle is not in the Code's text; it is a doctrine of the courts about material typicity.

readings.description: Not in general (Súmula 599), but for descaminho up to the ceiling of Lei 10.522/2002 art. 20 (today R$ 20.000) absent repeated conduct, unless the judge finds it socially advisable (Tema 157 and the reiteração thesis), and for cigarette contraband up to 1,000 packs absent repeated conduct (Tema 1143).

citations.cite: STJ Temas repetitivos 157 and 1143, and the reiteração thesis of 5.3.2024 (via TJMG)

readings.description: Never, as Súmula 599 reads on its face.

citations.cite: STJ's own repetitive theses carve out arts. 334 and 334-A (via TJMG)

readings.rejection_rationale: The STJ's later repetitive theses apply the principle to descaminho and cigarette contraband.

taken.rationale: Settled by the STJ's súmula and its own repetitive theses. No g6a crime except arts. 334 and 334-A has an insignificance exception; those two compute it from the facts the theses name, with the tax ceiling a parameter (M-sweep-c-16: a figure outside the Code).

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Corte Especial (Súmula 599); Terceira Seção (Temas 157 and 1143)
settled_by.citation: Súmula 599/STJ: "O princípio da insignificância é inaplicável aos crimes contra a administração pública."

witnesses: cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `o descaminho de vinte mil` (insignificant) and `o descaminho de vinte mil e um` (crime); `mil maços de cigarros` and `mil e um maços de cigarros`; `o descaminho pequeno reiterado` and `... mas recomendável`
notes: Reserved id from sweep-c; the fork spans Título XI with g6b, and g6a owns the lowest article (312), so g6a creates it and g6b cross-refers.

Tema 157 speaks of 'crimes tributários federais e de descaminho'. Whether it also reaches art. 337-A (a federal contribution) is not decided here: g6a applies Súmula 599 to art. 337-A and gives it no exception. Question for an expert.
M-sweep-c-17's source prints 'executada' where 'excetuada' is meant; the encoding reads 'excetuada'.

source.quote: Desobedecer a ordem legal de funcionário público

readings.description: Disobeying a lawful order to stop, given by public agents in ostensive policing, is typical under art. 330.
Not the crime of art. 330.
readings.rejection_rationale: STJ Tema repetitivo 1060 held the conduct typical.

taken.rationale: Settled by a repetitive-appeal thesis. The article already says so on its terms, so the rule has no exception to switch off; the record carries `ordem de parada emanada em policiamento ostensivo` and the rule does not read it.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Tema repetitivo 1060: "A desobediência à ordem legal de parada, emanada por agentes públicos em contexto de policiamento ostensivo, para a prevenção e repressão de crimes, constitui conduta penalmente típica, prevista no art. 330 do Código Penal Brasileiro."

witnesses: cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4: `a ordem de parada desobedecida` — crime, and equal to `a ordem desobedecida`
notes: The date is the acórdão's publication (1.4.2022) as M-sweep-c-22 gives it; the judgment date was not read.

site.anchor: crime de sonegação de contribuição previdenciária (art. 337-A)

source.quote: Suprimir ou reduzir contribuição social previdenciária e qualquer acessório, mediante as seguintes condutas:

readings.description: The crime is not made out (and prosecution cannot proceed) before the administrative procedure ends and the credit is definitively constituted.

citations.cite: MPF 2ª CCR Enunciado nº 79, as reproduced by Dizer o Direito (not a court; no STF or STJ holding on art. 337-A was read)

readings.description: No: SV 24's text is confined to Lei 8.137/1990 art. 1º, I-IV.

citations.cite: STF Súmula Vinculante 24 (text, via TJSP compilation)

readings.foreclosure: Not refuted: SV 24 names only Lei 8.137/1990. The encoding follows the extension because art. 337-A is, like those crimes, one of result ('suprimir ou reduzir'), and the sweep suggested it.

taken.rationale: The sweep's suggested reading. Encoded as a condition of the crime predicate, with the article's own words kept separately in `os elementos do art. 337-A`, so both readings are visible on one case.

witnesses: cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `a sonegação sem lançamento definitivo` — elements TRUE, crime FALSE
notes: The linking source is a prosecutors' statement quoted by a private site, so the fork is resolved on the encoder's argument, not settled.

site.anchor: funcionário público para os efeitos penais (art. 327)

source.quote: Equipara-se a funcionário público quem exerce cargo, emprego ou função em entidade paraestatal, e quem trabalha para empresa prestadora de serviço contratada ou conveniada para a execução de atividade típica da Administração Pública.

citations.cite: CP art. 327, caput ('para os efeitos penais') and § 1º

readings.description: The equiparação holds for every article that names a funcionário público, whether as the one who acts or as the one acted on (resistance, disobedience, contempt, active corruption).
The equiparação serves only to make the equated person a possible author of the crimes of Capítulo I; it does not make him a 'funcionário público' as victim.

citations.cite: CP art. 327, § 1º, placed in Capítulo I

readings.foreclosure: Nothing in § 1º limits it; the caput says 'para os efeitos penais'. A court could hold otherwise; no decision was read.

taken.rationale: The text sets no limit, and the caput's 'para os efeitos penais' is the widest scope the Code uses.

witnesses: cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4: `a resistência a terceirizada` — resistance to an equated person is the crime
notes: No authority on this was read; the sweep recorded none. Question for an expert.

source.quote: de órgão da administração direta, sociedade de economia mista, empresa pública ou fundação instituída pelo poder público

readings.description: The four bodies the paragraph names, and no others: an autarquia is not among them, and a heavier penalty may not be extended by analogy.
An autarquia is part of the public administration and falls within the paragraph's purpose, so its commissioned officers are reached too.
readings.foreclosure: The list is closed and an autarquia is an entity of the indirect administration, not an 'órgão da administração direta'; extending an increase by analogy is analogia in malam partem.

taken.rationale: The lead asked that § 2º's list be encoded exactly as worded; the text names four bodies. The fact supplier gives the kind of body; the rule reads the list.

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `a apropriação pelo servidor de autarquia` — no increase; `a apropriação pelo servidor em comissão` — increase
notes: `cp-dominio.l4`'s boolean `ocupa cargo em comissão ou função de direção ou assessoramento` folds this list into its gloss; g6a proposes the enum `Entidade da administração pública` in its place (PROPOSTO-COMUM) and does not read the boolean.

source.quote: quando os autores dos crimes previstos neste Capítulo forem ocupantes de cargos em comissão ou de função de direção ou assessoramento

readings.description: The increase reaches the crimes of Capítulo I only (arts. 312 to 326, 313-A, 313-B and 319-A included), and each author who personally holds such a post; a co-author who holds none is not reached.
It reaches every crime against the administration committed by such an officer.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'neste Capítulo' confines it to Capítulo I, where art. 327 sits.

readings.description: Once one author holds such a post, the increase reaches every author.
readings.foreclosure: A post held is a personal circumstance, not an element of the crime, so art. 30 keeps it from passing to a co-author; a court could read 'os autores' collectively.

taken.rationale: The words 'neste Capítulo' and art. 30. Only Capítulo I's rules call the increase, and a case record has one agent.

source.quote: CAPÍTULO I DOS CRIMES PRATICADOS POR FUNCIONÁRIO PÚBLICO CONTRA A ADMINISTRAÇÃO EM GERAL

citations.cite: CP, Parte Especial, Título XI, Capítulo I, heading

readings.description: Where an article of Capítulo I does not name its agent (arts. 313, 314, 315, 318, 319, 326), or names him as 'quem' (art. 325 § 1º) or 'agente público' (art. 319-A), the agent is a funcionário público under art. 327, as the chapter's heading says.
Where the article's own words do not require a funcionário — most plainly art. 326 ('Devassar o sigilo de proposta de concorrência pública') — anyone can commit it.
readings.foreclosure: A heading is part of the enacted text and places every article under it; most of these articles also speak of 'cargo', 'ato de ofício' or 'dever funcional'. Art. 326 is the one whose words would reach a private person.

taken.rationale: The heading is enacted text and every other article of the chapter presupposes an official; the arguable reading matters in practice only for art. 326.

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `o troco a mais do particular`
cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `a proposta devassada pelo particular`

source.quote: tentado, quando, iniciada a execução, não se consuma por circunstâncias alheias à vontade do agente

readings.description: An attempt is modelled where the conduct can be begun and stopped from outside: the intentional commissive forms. Not for the culpable form (art. 312 § 2º), nor for the omissions and one-act conducts (arts. 317 § 2º, 319, 319-A, 320, 323, 330, 331, 337-A).
Art. 14, II is general, so every crime has an attempted form.
readings.rejection_rationale: A want of care has no execution to interrupt, and an omission is either made or not; 'circunstâncias alheias à vontade' presupposes a willed result.

taken.rationale: The ordinary doctrine on art. 14, stated per article in the modules' headers. Arts. 330 and 331 are the debatable ones (a written disobedience or insult can be intercepted).

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `a apropriação tentada` (attempt, reduced) and `a apropriação abandonada` (no crime)
cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4: `a resistência tentada`
notes: Where an article punishes the attempt as the crime itself (art. 335, 'procurar afastar'), see F-g6a-18.

source.quote: Apropriar-se o funcionário público de dinheiro, valor ou qualquer outro bem móvel, público ou particular, de que tem a posse em razão do cargo, ou desviá-lo, em proveito próprio ou alheio:

readings.description: 'em proveito próprio ou alheio' qualifies both the appropriation and the diversion.
It qualifies only 'desviá-lo', which it follows; appropriation needs no stated benefit.
readings.foreclosure: The comma sets the phrase off from 'desviá-lo', and appropriating a thing is making it one's own, which is already a benefit to oneself or another; the readings differ only on an appropriation with no benefit to anyone.

taken.rationale: The comma, and § 1º's parallel 'em proveito próprio ou alheio' after both its verbs.

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `a apropriação sem proveito` — not peculato

source.quote: Se o funcionário concorre culposamente para o crime de outrem:

readings.description: 'o crime de outrem' is whatever crime another person committed with the want of care's help — typically a peculato or theft of what the official should have guarded; the fact supplier certifies it.
Only another's peculato, since the paragraph sits under art. 312.
readings.foreclosure: The text says 'crime', unqualified; nothing ties it to art. 312's own crime.

taken.rationale: The text does not narrow the crime; the encoding takes it as the text does.

delegated_field: `Fato de peculato`'s `crime de outrem` and `concurso culposo para o crime de outrem`

site.anchor: o efeito da reparação do dano no peculato culposo (art. 312, § 3º)

source.quote: a reparação do dano, se precede à sentença irrecorrível, extingue a punibilidade; se lhe é posterior, reduz de metade a pena imposta.

citations.cite: CP art. 337-A, § 1º ('antes do início da ação fiscal')

readings.description: A repair (art. 312 § 3º) or a declaration (art. 337-A § 1º) on the very day of the other event is neither 'before' nor 'after' it on the facts a date gives: the encoding refuses by name.
On the same day, the repair is taken to precede (in dubio pro reo).
readings.foreclosure: A presumption the text does not make; the time of day would decide it, and the record carries only dates.

readings.description: On the same day, the repair is taken to follow.
readings.rejection_rationale: Resolves a doubt against the accused with no text to support it.

taken.rationale: The lead asked that the deadline be encoded as written. 'precede' and 'posterior' leave the same day unanswered; a date cannot answer it.

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `reparado no dia da sentença` — refused; `reparado na véspera da sentença` and `reparado no dia seguinte à sentença`
cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `a declaração no dia da ação fiscal` — refused
notes: 'sentença irrecorrível' is read as the sentence no longer open to appeal (trânsito em julgado); a sentence not yet final is still ahead, so any repair so far precedes it.

source.quote: As penas são aumentadas de um terço até a metade se da modificação ou alteração resulta dano para a Administração Pública ou para o administrado.

readings.description: The increase changes the custodial range only; the fine keeps art. 49's limits.
'As penas', plural, reaches the fine too: the number of dias-multa rises by the same fraction.

taken.rationale: The shared machinery (`cp-pena.l4`, F-g0-28) scales the custodial range only; g0 left the fine to each encoder where the words reach it. g6a records the question and does not answer it for the fine.

notes: Question for an expert. The same plural appears nowhere else in g6a's range.
Unassessed: the machinery computes no number of dias-multa, so no test can show the two readings apart.

site.anchor: crime de violação de sigilo funcional (art. 325)

source.quote: se o fato não constitui crime mais grave

readings.description: Whether the fact makes out a graver crime needs the whole Code, so it is the judge's finding. Where it does, arts. 314, 325 (caput and § 1º, which incur 'as mesmas penas', clause and all) and 337 yield. § 2º of art. 325 prints its own preceito with no such clause, so a found graver crime does not take the qualified form away.

citations.cite: CP art. 325, § 1º ('Nas mesmas penas deste artigo')

readings.description: The clause belongs to the caput's preceito only; § 1º's 'mesmas penas' are the numbers, not the condition.
readings.foreclosure: 'as mesmas penas deste artigo' points at the preceito as printed, which carries the clause.

readings.description: The clause reaches § 2º too.
readings.foreclosure: § 2º prints a preceito of its own without it.

taken.rationale: PLAN § 2.2: the clause is a condition of the preceito, taken as an input finding, never as FALSE.

delegated_field: `crime mais grave, reconhecido pelo juiz` on the case records of arts. 314, 325 and 337
witnesses: cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `o segredo revelado em crime mais grave` (not the crime) and `o segredo revelado com dano em crime mais grave` (§ 2º stands)
cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `o processo extraviado em crime mais grave`

source.quote: ainda que fora da função ou antes de assumi-la, mas em razão dela

readings.description: One who demands or receives before taking up the function, but because of it, commits the crime although not yet an official under art. 327 on the day; for anyone else the art. 327 status on the day is required.
The agent must be a funcionário público on the day of the act.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would read 'antes de assumi-la' out of both articles.

taken.rationale: The words 'antes de assumi-la'.

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `a concussão antes de assumir` (crime) and `a exigência do particular` (not)
cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `a propina antes de assumir`

source.quote: Facilitar, com infração de dever funcional, a prática de contrabando ou descaminho (art. 334):

readings.description: The words name both crimes; the parenthesis points at the article that held both when it was written. Since Lei nº 13.008/2014 contrabando is art. 334-A, and facilitating it is still art. 318.
The pointer names art. 334, which since 2014 holds only descaminho: facilitating contrabando is outside art. 318.
readings.foreclosure: The operative words 'contrabando ou descaminho' name the crime; a stale pointer does not delete a word of the type.

taken.rationale: The type's words govern over its pointer.

witnesses: cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `o contrabando facilitado`

source.quote: Praticar violência, no exercício de função ou a pretexto de exercê-la:

readings.description: Art. 322 is in force as printed; the compiled text carries no revocation note, and the Senado record lists Lei nº 4.898/1965 against it only as 'Dispositivo Correlato'.
Art. 322 was tacitly revoked by the abuse-of-authority statute (Lei nº 4.898/1965, and now Lei nº 13.869/2019), which regulates the same matter.
readings.foreclosure: Neither statute is in the source bundle and no court decision was read; the sweep recorded none. The compiled text prints the article as in force.

taken.rationale: The source prints it as in force; the other reading needs statutes and case law the bundle does not hold.

witnesses: cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `a violência no exercício` — the crime on the taken reading; no crime on the other
notes: For the conductor and sweep-c: a question about tacit revocation that no sweep entry covers.

source.quote: Abandonar cargo público, fora dos casos permitidos em lei:

readings.description: Only the holder of a cargo público: the article names the cargo, not an emprego or a função.
Anyone who is a funcionário público under art. 327, whatever the post.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 327 says who is a funcionário; it does not turn an emprego into a 'cargo'. The heading 'Abandono de função' is the reading's best argument.

taken.rationale: The text's word; the heading 'Abandono de função' notwithstanding.

delegated_field: `Fato de abandono de função`'s `titular de cargo público`
witnesses: cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `o abandono de emprego público`

source.quote: Devassar o sigilo de proposta de concorrência pública, ou proporcionar a terceiro o ensejo de devassá-lo:

citations.cite: CP art. 337-J: 'Devassar o sigilo de proposta apresentada em processo licitatório ou proporcionar a terceiro o ensejo de devassá-lo' (Lei nº 14.133/2021)

readings.description: Arts. 326 and 335 are encoded as printed; the compiled text carries no revocation note on either.

Arts. 337-I, 337-J and 337-K, added by Lei nº 14.133/2021 with heavier penalties, regulate the same conduct in any licitação (a concorrência is one), so as later and special law they displace arts. 326 and 335 for licitações; art. 335 survives for the venda em hasta pública that is not a licitação.

taken.rationale: Displacement is a question of succession of laws across g6a's and g6b's articles, with no court decision read; g6a encodes its articles as the source prints them and flags the overlap for integration.

witnesses: cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `a proposta devassada` — art. 326 on the taken reading
notes: For the conductor and g6b: a fact of breaching a bid's secrecy in a concorrência is, on g6a's encoding, art. 326 (detenção de 3 meses a 1 ano) and, on g6b's, art. 337-J (detenção de 2 a 3 anos). Integration must say which governs.
Lei nº 8.666/1993 (arts. 93-95) raised the same question before 2021; it is not in the source bundle.

source.quote: As penas deste artigo são aplicáveis sem prejuízo das correspondentes à violência.

readings.description: Both penalties of the article carry the violence's own penalty besides (PLAN § 2.2.1, shape 4); where the means was a threat only, there is no violence and nothing is added.
The flag is set only where violence was used.

citations.cite: CP art. 329, caput ('mediante violência ou ameaça')

readings.foreclosure: Extensionally the same: the flag adds the violence's penalty, and a threat has none.

taken.rationale: The paragraph speaks of 'as penas deste artigo', and PLAN lists it among the article-wide ones.

source.quote: A pena aplica-se em dobro se o crime de descaminho é praticado em transporte aéreo, marítimo ou fluvial.

readings.description: 'o crime de descaminho' (and 'de contrabando') is the article's crime, the forms of § 1º, which incur 'a mesma pena', included.

citations.cite: CP arts. 334 and 334-A, § 1º ('Incorre na mesma pena')

readings.description: Only the caput's conduct, the one that crosses a border, can be 'praticado em transporte aéreo, marítimo ou fluvial'.
readings.foreclosure: The paragraph names the crime, not the caput; most § 1º forms would rarely meet the condition anyway.

taken.rationale: The words 'o crime de descaminho' / 'de contrabando'.

notes: Whether regular commercial flights count as 'transporte aéreo' for § 3º is a question the courts have addressed; nothing on it was read. Question for an expert.

source.quote: afastar ou procurar afastar concorrente ou licitante, por meio de violência, grave ameaça, fraude ou oferecimento de vantagem

readings.description: 'procurar afastar' makes the attempt the crime itself: once the agent has begun to remove a bidder by those means, the crime is consummated, with no art. 14 reduction.

citations.cite: CP art. 14, parágrafo único ('Salvo disposição em contrário')

readings.description: An interrupted removal is an attempt, reduced under art. 14.
readings.rejection_rationale: The text names 'procurar afastar' beside 'afastar'; that is the 'disposição em contrário' art. 14's parágrafo único reserves.

taken.rationale: The text.

witnesses: cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `o licitante que se procurou afastar` — consummated, no reduction

source.quote: A extinção de punibilidade de que trata o § 1º deste artigo não se aplica ao agente declarado devedor contumaz em decisão administrativa definitiva e inscrito no Cadastro Informativo dos créditos não quitados do setor público federal (Cadin)

readings.description: § 5º removes a ground of extinction, so it is harsher law and reaches only acts done from LC nº 225/2026's vigência (9.1.2026) on; § 6º then fixes the status at the time of those acts.

citations.cite: CP art. 337-A, § 6º ('em relação aos atos praticados no período')

readings.description: What matters is when the declaration is made: after 9.1.2026, a declared persistent debtor loses § 1º whatever the date of the acts.
readings.foreclosure: Extinction of punishability is material law; applying § 5º to earlier acts would make the harsher law retroact. § 6º speaks of 'os atos praticados no período'.

readings.description: § 5º applies to every agent declared a persistent debtor, whenever the acts.

taken.rationale: CP art. 2º and § 6º's own reference to the acts.

witnesses: cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `o contumaz que declarou por atos anteriores à LC 225` (extinguished) and `... do dia da LC 225` (not)

site.anchor: a punibilidade da sonegação de contribuição previdenciária está extinta

source.quote: É extinta a punibilidade se o agente, espontaneamente, declara e confessa as contribuições, importâncias ou valores e presta as informações devidas à previdência social, na forma definida em lei ou regulamento, antes do início da ação fiscal.

readings.description: Two grounds, each enough on its own: the Code's spontaneous declaration before the ação fiscal (§ 1º), and full payment by the connected legal entity at any time (Lei nº 10.684/2003, art. 9º, § 2º), which the parcelamento suspends meanwhile (art. 9º, caput). Neither for the declared persistent debtor, for acts from LC nº 225/2026's vigência.
Only the Code's § 1º.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 9º of Lei nº 10.684/2003 names art. 337-A (M-sweep-c-28, binding).

readings.description: Lei nº 9.430/1996, art. 83, as amended in 2011, is later and more specific: suspension needs a parcelamento requested before the denúncia is received, and extinction follows the payment of a parcelled debt.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 83 was not read by any sweep for art. 337-A; art. 9º's own text sets no time for payment. Sweep-b records the question for art. 168-A as F-sweep-b-03.

taken.rationale: M-sweep-c-28's disposition: implement art. 9º beside § 1º. The two are exported separately and together (`a punibilidade da sonegação de contribuição previdenciária está extinta`).

witnesses: cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `a dívida paga depois da ação fiscal` — not extinct under § 1º, extinct under art. 9º, § 2º
notes: Arts. 168-A (g3's) and 337-A should share one predicate for art. 9º at integration (M-sweep-c-28's note); g6a's is `extinção da punibilidade pelo pagamento integral (Lei nº 10.684, de 2003, art. 9º, § 2º)`.
Prescription does not run during the suspension (art. 9º, § 1º): for g1c's prescription rules, which can read `a pretensão punitiva está suspensa pelo parcelamento (Lei nº 10.684, de 2003, art. 9º)`.

site.anchor: as opções do juiz pelo art. 337-A, § 3º

source.quote: O valor a que se refere o parágrafo anterior será reajustado nas mesmas datas e nos mesmos índices do reajuste dos benefícios da previdência social.

readings.description: The ceiling in force is R$ 1.510,00 carried forward by every readjustment of the social-security benefits; those are published figures outside the source, so the ceiling is a parameter of the rule, and the encoding, asked for it itself, refuses by name.
Use R$ 1.510,00 as printed.
readings.rejection_rationale: § 4º says the value is readjusted; the printed figure is the value of 2000.

readings.description: The encoding cannot answer § 3º at all.
readings.foreclosure: Answerable once a caller supplies the published figure, as art. 49's minimum wage is supplied; the named refusal covers the case where nobody does.

taken.rationale: The lead's instruction not to hard-code an adjustment the source does not show, and the precedent of art. 49's minimum wage in `cp-pena.l4`.

witnesses: cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4: `as opções do juiz pelo art. 337-A, § 3º` with the refusal constant — refused; with an example value — the options
notes: The independent test author's case IT-g6-192 expects REFUSE (notes/conductor.md); the named refusal `o valor do art. 337-A, § 3º, reajustado na forma do § 4º, não está na fonte` is that answer.

source.quote: Esta Lei entra em vigor noventa dias após a data de sua publicação.

LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º (incluído pela LC nº 107/2001)

readings.description: In force on 15.10.2000: counting the day of publication in, as LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º prescribes.
readings.foreclosure: That counting rule was inserted by LC nº 107/2001, after Lei nº 9.983/2000 was published; whether it governs an earlier law is not settled here.

readings.description: In force on 16.10.2000: leaving the day of publication out and starting the law on day 91.
readings.foreclosure: Not the count LC nº 95/1998 now prescribes.

readings.description: A fact on 15.10.2000 is refused by name; before it, the provisions Lei nº 9.983/2000 added are not law; from 16.10.2000, they are.

citations.cite: sweep-c S-sweep-c-15 ('a one-day uncertainty not resolved here')

taken.rationale: The sweep established the clause and left the day open; one day in October 2000 is not worth a guess, and a refusal says so.
